name: hypertask_comments
does: Without a kind, a reply target or an @mention of a person (and no images or attachments), an agent comment is saved to the hidden ticket agent log, which people do not see. To post for people, pass kind: question for a decision by a person, qa for a QA verdict, or done for the closing summary. List comments and activity, add replies, and edit or delete permitted comments.
use_when: Use to discuss a ticket or inspect its conversation; list with include_activity also retrieves work history.
do_not_use_when: Do not use for ticket descriptions or unpublished drafts; use hypertask_tasks or hypertask_drafts instead.
parameters_and_caveats: action selects an operation; input contains only that operation’s documented fields. response_format defaults to concise for reads; detailed retains full fields. limit defaults to 20 (maximum 50) and offset defaults to 0 for bounded read results; use returned pagination or narrower filters. text is HTML unless content_type=markdown; comment_id is required to edit or delete, and ticket identifiers locate list/add targets. Ownership and board membership still apply.
